feeds.title: All Ag News
feeds.description: Ag News From The Nation's Only Full-Time Farm Station

feeds.title: Farm Journal
feeds.description: Farm Journal delivers the most widely used, trusted and relevant business information throughout American agriculture. As the nation's recognized leader in agriculture content, data, and business insights, we serve every key audience in agriculture, including crop farmers, livestock producers, the produce supply chain, and ag retailers.

feeds.title: Agweek
feeds.description: Agweek is the top source for agriculture news and information, agriculture news and farming trends, issues, and crop details in North Dakota, Minnesota, and South Dakota. Owned and operated by Forum Communications, Agweek has been consistently delivering quality journalism covering Agriculture and related industries.

feeds.title: Brownfield Ag News
feeds.description: Brownfield Ag News covers news, markets, weather, and features relevant to those who live and work on farms and in rural communities in the United States, and to all with an interest in U.S. food and ag. Discover Top Stories concerning Crops, Dairy, Livestock New USDA regulation and more.

feeds.title: AGDAILY
feeds.description: Agdaily develops smart, engaging, and innovative content for production farming and rural living and is the premier digital destination for agriculture news, trends, and rural lifestyle -- a forward-thinking site for a forward-thinking industry. Get the latest Agriculture News, Trends & Farming Videos from Agdaily.

feeds.title: The Western Producer
feeds.description: The Western Producer delivers Canadian farmers the latest in agricultural news, production, and technology as well as podcasts, videos, and market data. The Western Producer is a leading agricultural publication targeted at Western Canadian farmers and ranchers and has been a staple in the agricultural industry since 1923.

feeds.title: The New York Times » Agriculture & Farming
feeds.description: News about Agriculture and Farming, including commentary and archival articles published in The New York Times. Stay current with comprehensive coverage of Agriculture and related industries. The New York Times is a leading national daily and digital news outlet dedicated to on-the-ground, expert, and deeply reported independent journalism.

feeds.title: Country Life in BC
feeds.description: Our team of writers and columnists helps us deliver news, stories, and information that will help BC farmers and ranchers understand their industry better and grow their businesses. Our weekly newspaper, Country Life in BC is the top agricultural news source for farmers and ranchers in British Columbia.

feeds.title: California Ag Network
feeds.description: California Ag Network is the online hub for agricultural news in the Golden State and covers it all as the farmer's go-to source for daily industry news. A product of Malcolm Media and other renowned Ag Publications, farmers and sponsoring Ag companies alike benefit greatly from connecting on this site.

feeds.title: Northern Ag Network
feeds.description: The Northern Ag Network provides hourly farm news and market reports, weather programs, and special features. In addition, the Northern Ag Network produces two daily Ag Television programs each morning, which are seen on nine of Montana's premier television stations.

feeds.title: ScienceDaily » Agriculture and Food
feeds.description: Agricultural research news covering from fertilizers and organic farming to maximizing crops and hybridization read about advancements in agriculture. ScienceDaily features breaking news about the latest discoveries in science, health, the environment, technology, and more from leading universities, scientific journals, and research organizations.

feeds.title: Agriculture Post
feeds.description: Agriculture Post is a knowledge-sharing platform focusing on the transformations taking place in the agriculture sector in India and globally. Agriculture Post takes the research and the necessary knowledge from the lab to the land of the farming community. It seeks to share solutions for increasing food production, facilitates sustainable use of land, water, and human resources, and more.

feeds.title: CropLife
feeds.description: Explore must-know developments in Agriculture and FoodTech. CropLife is the nation's brand leader in ag retail communication. CropLife offers unmatched market reach through relevant, impactful brand extensions focused exclusively on the input distribution channel, including CropLife eNews and CropLife Webinars.

feeds.title: Food and Environment Reporting Network
feeds.description: A news organization that produces in-depth & investigative journalism in the critically underreported areas of food, agriculture, and environmental health. Through partnerships with local & national mainstream media outlets, we seek to tell stories that will inspire, inform, and have a lasting impact.

feeds.title: The Fence Post
feeds.description: The Fence Post is a nationwide agricultural newspaper covering a wide range of readers each week. Each issue and the website of The Fence Post contains auction details, obituaries, recipes, cartoons, event coverage, and human interest stories all pertaining to the agricultural business. We strive to keep a high level of customer service to our Farmer readers.

feeds.title: Morning Ag Clips
feeds.description: Morning Ag Clips sends out breaking local and national agricultural news every day through our state-by-state blast, on the web, and in our app. Our audience made up of farmers, ranchers, and ag industry leaders come to us for quick one-two on agriculture happenings every day. We are one of America's most trusted Ag News Sources.

feeds.title: Farms.com
feeds.description: Farms.com Ltd. is a leading provider of innovative information products and services for the global agriculture and food industries. Our vision is to be an essential partner to our global agriculture and food industry customers; by exceeding their expectations through value-added & integrated information-driven services and solutions enabled by technology.

feeds.title: Michigan Ag Today
feeds.description: The home of Michigan agriculture news and the voice for Michigan farms and agribusinesses. Michigan Ag Today brings a refreshing outlook and smart coverage of the Michigan Agro Industries, Weather and Market Report. Together with its Radio station and Digital outlet, Michigan Ag serves diligently to deliver everything Agro-related it's viewers.

feeds.title: Farmtario
feeds.description: Farmtario is a new source of farming information. We provide the most useful independent insight for Ontario farmers, including news, crop and livestock production, markets and a deep understanding of how technology and data are being adopted on farms.

feeds.title: Alberta Farmer Express
feeds.description: Alberta Farmer Express provides daily agriculture news, features, videos, event listings, and a daily newsletter to Alberta farmers and ranchers. Alberta Farmer Express is widely recognized as the place where Alberta farmers and ranchers find out what's happening in agriculture, whether it's on local farms or on farms around the world.

feeds.title: Country Guide
feeds.description: As Canada's longest-running farm publication, Country Guide provides Canadian farmers with the latest in agriculture. Published by Glacier FarmMedia LP, Country Guide is about the business of farming, providing farmers with strategic business thinking. Along with its website, it provides daily agriculture news, event listings, and more.

feeds.title: Farm and Dairy
feeds.description: Farm and Dairy is a rural Ohio newspaper providing useful, timely, and valuable information to our readers and, in turn, offers our advertisers a loyal, defined audience in order to market their products. Operated by a family-owned company, Farm and Dairy is committed to news, auction information, farm classifieds, and advertising -- both in print and online.

feeds.title: American Ag Network
feeds.description: The American Ag Network brings timely and accurate ag market, news, and weather to the nation's airwaves through our affiliate stations, as well as online at americanagnetwork.com. We're dedicated to telling the story of agriculture: from keeping producers informed, to educating consumers about the journey from the field to the dinner table

feeds.title: Western Ag Reporter
feeds.description: Western Ag Reporter is one of the largest-read, weekly agriculture newspapers in the industry. We provide unbiased industry coverage across multiple northwestern states, while also valuing our readers and their opinions. Read the latest updates from Agro and Livestock Industries.

feeds.title: FarmingPortal
feeds.description: FarmingPortal is an Independent and impartial News source that makes Farming and Agriculture easy to read, hear, view and understand for local farmers. Our daily users are real Professional Commercial Farmers and Upcoming Farmers with the ability to create wealth. We only post Professional Articles in script, Video and Audio.

feeds.title: AgFunderNews
feeds.description: AFN is a news site dedicated to publishing daily, original news about the burgeoning food tech and agtech startup and venture capital industry. Browse the latest articles and news on agriculture technology, food technology, ag investing, startups and more.

feeds.title: Vegetable Growers News
feeds.description: Vegetable Growers News is a powerful and reliable resource for vegetable growers across the nation. Published monthly, each issue features the latest news, insights, products, and more to ensure successful growing operations. Discover in-depth features that provide the insight and knowledge necessary to stay competitive in the marketplace.

feeds.title: AGCanada
feeds.description: AGCanada is the online portal for Glacier FarmMedia, Canada's largest publisher of newspapers and magazines for farmers. Here you'll find the online connections to Country Guide, Grainews, Canadian Cattlemen, the Manitoba Co-operator, and Alberta Farmer Express, and access to their digital editions in a searchable online format.
